name: Shortest tube wavelength (Duane–Hunt)
meaning: Shortest X-ray wavelength (nm) from a tube at voltage V; eV is the electron kinetic energy in eV (numerically equal to V in volts).

name: Moseley's law (approximate)
meaning: Approximate Kα photon energy for an element of atomic number Z; about 8.0 keV for copper (Z = 29).

name: Bragg's law
meaning: Condition for constructive X-ray diffraction from planes spaced d (nm) apart; λ wavelength (nm), θ angle from the planes, n = 1, 2, 3, … the order. Diffractometers report 2θ.

name: Cubic interplanar spacing
meaning: Spacing (nm) between adjacent (hkl) planes in a cubic crystal with lattice parameter a (nm).

name: Lattice parameter vs atomic radius
meaning: Cube edge a from atomic radius R for hard-sphere atoms touching along the face diagonal (FCC) or body diagonal (BCC).

name: Indexing a cubic pattern
meaning: sin²θ values are proportional to N = h²+k²+l²; their ratios reveal SC (1,2,3,4,5,6,8), BCC (2,4,6,8,…), or FCC (3,4,8,11,12,…).

name: Planar density and spacing
meaning: Atoms per unit area on a plane (nm⁻²) equals atoms per unit volume (nm⁻³) times the spacing between adjacent atom-bearing planes (nm); exact for one atom per lattice point.

name: Relativistic electron wavelength
meaning: de Broglie wavelength (m) of an electron accelerated through V volts; 0.0037 nm at 100 kV, 0.0025 nm at 200 kV.
